<div class="jhs-album-intro">
  <p class="jhs-page-intro">
  A few days of walking Copenhagen end to end, where copper spires and painted gables give
  way to glass, steel, and folded concrete within a couple of blocks, almost every good view
  turns out to be from a bridge — and one afternoon indoors at the Museum of Illusions, in
  rooms built to argue with the camera.</p>
</div>
